author: Rabona
body:
Hey,

I created this thread to see you guys work your thinking caps. Every other day, I will post out two new riddles. Each person has one shot at each riddle. Some will be easy and some will be hard or close to impossible. Here are the first two:

1.   (Impossible)                                                            
He comes to bedsides, icy bridges,               
battlefronts, and crumbling ridges.
When he comes, he comes alone,
taps a shoulder, then is gone.

2.    (Medium)
Guided to guide others,
makes trails where it goes,
gets shorter with age,
but won't melt or glow.

Riddle 1: Answer: Death: Solved By : DaGoldBrick

Good Luck.
